TED Foundation Inc (EIN 82-1934592) filings

https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/821934592

Four 990-PF XMLs grepped from the S3 mirror: 202242949349100909 (TY2021, 3 Part XV groups), 202322779349100017 (TY2022, 6), 202442359349100919 (TY2023, 1), 202502549349100435 (TY2024, 2: Aboriginal Housing Management $63,084; Zero Emissions Innovation Centre $37,169). No METR, RAND, Model Evaluation or Canary line.

Signals citing this source

  • METR, F (for): TED Foundation's 990-PFs show no grant to METR, RAND, or Canary in TY2021-2024, and the Audacious Project's own FAQ says TED itself does not fund grantees; the only filed Canary payments are Valhalla ($10M) and High Tide ($333,334) paying RAND directly in TY2024, with no METR line. METR's approximately $17M Audacious share is therefore confirmed at the RAND/Canary level but not, in any filing checked, at the METR level.
